status: Proposed protocol, not implemented or executed
supersedes: The fixed six-turn capture design in results/multiturn-preference-capture-plan.json; retain that file as historical evidence
hypothesis: Sparse late challenges and clean scripted histories underrepresent contexts encountered by the deployed student; model-generated mistakes may compound as conversations grow.
not_assumed: Assistant instruction tuning is the established cause in Qwen3-4B-Base
All small models necessarily drift at all long lengths
Turn count and token context length are interchangeable
A candidate that refuses every request has a good independent personality
method: Stratified Monte Carlo conversation rollouts with sparse branches; no full tree search or automatic reinforcement from the model's self-ratings

sampling.pilot: Two new training-only scenario families, two generation seeds each; challenge branches after four and eight completed exchanges. Four independent roots, eight challenge branches. Feasibility pilot, not a quality benchmark.
sampling.expansion: If runtime and labeling are workable, eight training families times two seeds: sixteen roots; branch after 4, 8, 16 and 32 completed exchanges, subject to explicit memory/token feasibility. Sixty-four challenge branches if all depths finish.
sampling.ordinary_spine: Maintain an unchallenged conversation spine with the student's actual previous replies. Let caller turns respond coherently to events; sample topic changes, emotional tone, verbosity and corrections. Preserve every generated candidate and partner provenance.
sampling.challenge_branch: Clone a prefix on disk, introduce one challenge, then continue three ordinary caller exchanges to measure recovery. Never feed a branch's challenge or answer back into the unchallenged spine.
sampling.placement: Balance challenge types across depths; matched branches use semantically equivalent challenges to estimate position effects. Add no-challenge controls. Training examples mix terminal challenges and mid-conversation challenges followed by recovery.
sampling.branch_replicates: Initially one sampled completion path per branch; add paired seeds at selected failures and matched successful controls only as a separately logged diagnostic.
sampling.randomness: Record root, caller, challenge and completion seeds separately, plus checkpoint, tokenizer, serialization and scenario hashes. Fix the sampling policy before each comparison.
sampling.context: Record exact input token count, exchange count, output tokens, finish reason and any truncation. A resource-limited branch is incomplete, never a pass. No silent rolling-window truncation or profile reminders.

diagnostic_controls: At selected failed prefixes, compare actual history with a minimally reviewed history that corrects earlier Jun errors while preserving caller facts, length as closely as possible, and referential coherence. This is an intervention, not a claim of perfect causal isolation.
Compare brief versus verbose coherent histories at matched exchange count to probe token-length effects; compare different exchange counts within matched token bands where feasible.
Keep an ordinary no-pressure condition to distinguish spontaneous drift from challenge susceptibility.
Test a privileged-profile teacher on the same histories before trusting its labels. Teacher metadata stays out of student input; rejected teachers produce no training targets.

metrics.primary: Character survival by turn and token band: first independently reviewed hard break, with unfinished trajectories right-censored rather than counted successful.
secondary: challenge failure rate by depth and type
persistence of an error over subsequent turns
metrics.labels: Separate hard identity/lore/perception contradictions from memory mistakes, assistant-like style and subjective awkwardness. Helping a caller is not itself an identity failure. Preserve uncertainty and disagreements.
metrics.uncertainty: Branches sharing a root are correlated. Show root counts and raw counts; cluster resampling by root, and scenario-level sensitivity when sample size supports it. Do not report 64 branches as 64 independent conversations.
metrics.adaptive_search: Oversampled failure branches are training diagnostics. Keep a separate fixed sampling distribution for before/after comparisons; do not present adaptively mined failure rate as natural conversation prevalence.

training_conversion.targets: Review exact on-policy prefixes; teach a coherent corrected next reply and, where needed, a recovery continuation. Earlier erroneous assistant replies remain context with zero positive-target loss.
training_conversion.balance: Mix reviewed successful ordinary continuations and clean SFT replay with failure corrections. Limit repeated descendants from one root so one failure family cannot dominate.
training_conversion.length_curriculum: Train challenges at varied positions, not only endings. Token-length curriculum must preserve the actual conditioning history; 32 exchanges that exceed a 1024-token training cap cannot be claimed as full-history training.
training_conversion.memory_constraint: Validate a feasible gradient method at each admitted token length. Frozen-prefix or truncated-gradient methods, if required, must be named and tested as approximations rather than described as equivalent full-context gradients.
training_conversion.admission: Declare optimizer, objective, dataset counts and resource protocol separately after capture and review. No automatic training launch from this plan.

evaluation_integrity: Split by scenario family and all descendants before synthesis. Training rollouts never reuse exposed final/pressure prompts, answers or deliberate paraphrases. Existing acceptance gates remain; future release requires fresh families and seeds. Same-author reviews are not independent human evaluation.
execution_order: Finish runtime mitigation review, including hidden wired-limit calls in dependencies; use one model process and persist phase breadcrumbs
Complete saved run22 final capture review and explicitly select a research parent; do not call it accepted
Implement token-accounted, resumable sampling and verify it without model loading
Run bounded shallow pilot, then expand only within measured limits
Review rollouts, quantify the failure mechanisms and teacher advantage, then declare the next training experiment
